checks: At any sampled base p, the actual hull fiber bounds every anchored weighted sum of support heights by h_p, and the singleton gives equality. Finite LP duality applies on the compact representation polytope and yields an attained affine touching majorant.

An optimal majorant with fewer than r+1 independent active evaluations admits a nonzero direction annihilating the active rows. Both infinitesimal signs are feasible and hence the objective pairing is zero. Choose the sign reaching a new constraint. The evaluation that moves is independent of the active rows. This terminates at one of finitely many interpolation patterns, including the constant pattern at r=0. Extending the linear part by zero on the orthogonal complement preserves the chosen affine equation after choosing its intercept.

The coefficients are bounded continuous functions of the unit normal for each interpolation pattern, and choosing the first admissible interpolant is Borel. The supported input point is a regular support maximizer; the output slack is nonnegative, and its global integral is zero by testing the physical martingale with bounded Borel source coefficients.

Localization by the source label is justified with countably many continuous physical tests on the compact input support. Each coordinate signed measure then vanishes for all Borel tests on a common full-label set. The conditional quadratic expansion drops both cross terms, and every remaining increment is tangent to the selected face. This gives positivity, the two block equations and zero affine moments. Target labels use disintegration of the actual output law and need not coincide with the deterministic source selector.

For the three translated disks, interpolation gives the exact sheared cylinder. Equal routing to p=-1,0,1 preserves the boundary angular law and has mean zero in the base displacement. Exact second moment is 2/3, giving Q=(2/3)(1,t)(1,t)^T and its kernel (-u·t,u); κ has angular density 3r_0. Both original source locators match.
The frozen candidate digest matches the intake freeze record, and the archived source digests match both the pinned checkout and its Git objects.

dependencies.hypotheses: The finite positive fibers satisfy exactly the actual hull-section hypothesis. The boundary area marginal and its nonnegative density lift to regular normals, including counting at both interval endpoints. Equal-mass physical convex order therefore gives existence and the mark preservation of every such martingale.

It does not give finite interpolant indices with conditional covariance matrices, disintegrated target ownership and the curved calibration.
